registered_after: PR2 W1-only scores generated; before any donor PCA factors or PR3 scores
inputs: actual V1 before FFN0; cached W1 QDQ and known b1/s2/W2/gate; training source task0 only
factorization: FP32 full SVD of centered donor V1[512,5120]; P=right singular vectors; B=W1@P; mu=donor mean
prediction: ((V1-mu)@P_r)@B_r.T+W1@mu+b1 in FP32, then BF16/native GELU(tanh), s2 compensation and native HiF4 Q2
score: same original-group FP32 C projection and FP64 energy as AR2
energy_residual: same donor-only weighted groupwise residual-on-input-energy LS as PR2; training scores must use donor own PCA, test scores opposite-seed donor PCA
donor: task0 opposite seed, same step/expert/block20; never test PCA or test H/V2/Z/Delta for prediction
support: 216 original groups64; top108 stable group-ID ties
gain_fit: bias-free actual training V2 signals under donor own PCA predicted supports; target is donor dense FP32 signal
primary_gate: proxy<=0.8 random and <=0.9 C_static and <=1.1 true C_dynamic; >=3/4 with both seeds and steps per source
selection: minimum rank passing task0 Fit gate, raw preferred at equal rank; task6 Validation only reports this choice, other ranks sensitivity. No Fit pass means route fails.
control_use: reuse verified PR2 operator controls on identical inputs/weights; excluded from selection
precision: GPU FP32 factors/prediction, native CPU BF16 risk primary and matched FP32 control
deployment_status: row-wise diagnostic; no tile-sharing, online cost, full sparse FFN or video claim
